study: candidate filters, fixed existing shape/ranking and fixed 4-session/-6% exit

filters.baseline: 原完整形态候选、原评分，创业板每日前2
filters.index_ma20: 沪深300信号日收盘严格高于当日20日均线；缺失不填充
filters.breadth_50: 所有当日有效创业板股票的上涨比例>=50%；平盘计入分母
filters.momentum_0_30: 个股10交易日收盘动量严格>0且严格<30%
filters.breakout_volume_le3: 原策略定义的突破量比<=3，保留原放量下限
filters.prior_extreme_lt15: T-10至T-1最大单日复权收盘涨幅严格<15%；不含T

historical_score_control.definition: 原四项等权25/25/25/25，保留当前收盘涨停过滤，仅重排完整原形态候选

selection.eligibility: closed>=80 AND payoff_ratio>1 AND profit_factor>1 AND mean_net>0; both wins and losses required
selection.ranking: training unrounded payoff descending, PF descending, mean descending, scenario id ascending

breadth_definition: current catalog six-digit 300/301 STOCK; same-day and prior market-day finite positive qfq closes plus same-day volume>0; no ST/status narrowing, no forward-fill, no future quote membership
limitations: 当前证券目录、名称/状态存在幸存者及历史成员偏差，非严格PIT证券池。
2026-09-29案例与2026年结果已经观察且参与当前五项评分校准，2026仅后验检验。
2025H2是本轮过滤选择未开启的留出期；基底策略本身并非2024年事前冻结设计。
每笔独立事件交易，不模拟组合容量、资金占用或组合净值。
